items.text:
It's quite sad, I really enjoyed and had a great time with NeoScavengers!

All the Immersive sim elements, the open world survival crafting (which is a surprise to me), the tile based inventory, the grid based overworld, turn based combat. It just needed abit more polish and content but still have fond memories.

I was really looking forward to Ostranuats as a deep immersive top down space sim, but sadly outside political forces have left some very negative marks that hamper any amount of enjoyment I might have.

I wasn't at all expecting the SJW factors that are heavily in your face at character creation, when all I wanted to do was just hop in and start playing.

The fact that your character has sexual relations with other NPCs while you're not playing, even those of other genders if you choose, and apparently your character is automatically made gay by default if you just create a new character without checking? As another said I did not want a sexual dating sim implanted into a complex, hardcore space sim. Was not expecting this at all from the dev based on their last game NeoScavengers.

I was having a on topic discussion about this with others and it's biblical ramifications that was entirely within my rights to do so when a moderator perma-banned me for being "off topic" when I obviously was not.

Whether or not the devs hate theology or Christians remains to be seen, but so far it seems to be so, false banning anyone who talks about anything pro-Christian in their forums.

items.text:
This is writen as v.0.13.14, so usual caveats of being in early development apply. That said, development is active and updates from devs are quite frequent.

If you like problemsolving (or bughunting!) and salvaging/survival games this will have some nice gameplay already. There is a large focus on social interactions as well. Unfortuinately at this point, the NPCs are too unreliable to be profitable. They can be used for short projects, but they can get stuck in an inactive state or just walk out the airlock without air sometimes. Devs are very much fixing up these bugs. Also personally I'd like to have my character assume other's gender based on observable characteristics, as it stands  everybody is nonbinary I guess?

As this game has quite a granular focus on detail and procedural systems, reminiscent of Dwarf Fortress, emergent behaviour is a constant source of entertainment for those who are not allergic to rough edges.

I personally am enjoying it quite much, now that there is a bit more guidance in-game on how all the knobs and buttons work. 
There are parallels to games like Space Haven, DV Rings of Saturn and Hardspace Shipbreaker, so if you like those titles, you will probably like this one as well. Go check it out and contribute your experiences!
items.text_zh:
这是以v.0.13.14版本写的，所以处于早期开发阶段的常见警告都适用。话虽如此，开发很活跃，开发者的更新相当频繁。

如果你喜欢解决问题（或者找bug！）以及打捞/生存游戏，这款游戏已经有一些不错的玩法了。社交互动也是一个很大的重点。不幸的是，在目前这个阶段，NPC太不可靠了，无法带来收益。他们可以用于短期项目，但有时会卡在非活跃状态，或者有时会不穿宇航服直接走出气闸。开发者正在大力修复这些bug。另外，我个人希望我的角色能根据可观察特征来推断他人的性别，就目前而言，每个人都是非二元性别吧？

由于这款游戏对细节和程序化系统有着相当精细的关注，让人想起《矮人要塞》，涌现行为对于那些不对粗糙边缘过敏的人来说是持续的娱乐来源。

我个人非常享受这款游戏，现在游戏内关于各种旋钮和按钮如何运作的引导多了一些。
它与《Space Haven》、《DV Rings of Saturn》和《Hardspace Shipbreaker》等游戏有相似之处，所以如果你喜欢那些作品，你很可能也会喜欢这款。去看看吧，并贡献你的体验！

items.text:
-install game
-first thing I'm asked about in the character creator is my pronouns
-have to randomize my character until I get someone that doesn't look like a retarded zoomer
-go through career
-one of the events has me seduce someone I don't know the name of, find out afterwards it's a dude, so I guess my character is gay now (apparently spent a good year getting bum bandited by him)
-finally get to my salvage pod and set course for a derelict ship
-the spaceship controls that Fedor made look so cool in his dev videos are some of the most unintuitive and clunky controls I've tried in a video game
-before I manage to get to the derelict, my pod runs out of battery power and everything goes dark
-after two restarts I realize there's an extra battery I can install for more juice (why this isn't installed from the get-go is beyond me)
-this has to be placed facing in the correct direction or it won't work (something that there's no indication of besides some tiny arrows on the battery itself)
-with my newfound power, I head for the derelict again
-crash into it, destroying my pod and asphyxiating my character
-manage after a few more restarts to dock with a derelict
-is confronted by a pitch-black hallway with locked crates and a door I can't open because I didn't buy a crowbar at the start shop (something that there isn't any indication of that you should do)
-while I'm trying to reroute conduits to power the door, my pod runs out of juice again
-alt+F4 and restart again again again
-this time around the derelict that I reach already have the door open
-manage to fire up the reactor and get power
-start pulling up floor from a room I don't need in order to fix the holes in the hull since I didn't get hull patches from the shop (again, game did not tell me I should do this)
-go back to salvage pod to replenish air in suit
-the temperature inside my pod is 78 sextillion kelvin, and the pressure is 22 sextillion kilopascal for some universe-bending reason
-die from organ failure
-rage, alt+F4, and go write this review

Game is offensively unready for even early access.

Fedor, if you read this, cut ties with the woke publisher you've signed up with for some ungodly reason, purge the entire game of any woke ♥♥♥♥, and go back and crunch out the bugs for another half a year before releasing this again. This is just insulting.
items.text_zh:
-安装游戏
-在角色创建器里，第一件被问到的事就是我的代词
-不得不随机化我的角色，直到随机出一个看起来不像弱智Z世代的人
-经历职业生涯
-其中一个事件让我去勾引一个我连名字都不知道的人，事后才发现那是个男的，所以我想我的角色现在是同性恋了（显然还跟他被爆菊了整整一年）
-终于到达我的打捞舱，设定航线前往一艘废弃飞船
-费多尔在他的开发视频里让飞船操控看起来那么酷，实际却是我在电子游戏里试过的最不直观、最笨重的操控之一
-还没等我到达那艘废弃飞船，我的舱就没电了，一切陷入黑暗
-重启两次后我才意识到有一块额外的电池可以安装来获得更多电量（为什么这玩意不是一开始就装好的，我实在想不通）
-这东西必须朝向正确的方向放置，否则就不会工作（除了电池本身上的几个小箭头之外，没有任何提示）
-带着新获得的电力，我再次前往那艘废弃飞船
-撞上了它，摧毁了我的舱，让我的角色窒息而死
-又重启几次后，终于成功与一艘废弃飞船对接
-迎面是一条漆黑一片的走廊，里面有锁着的板条箱，还有一扇我打不开的门，因为我在开局商店里没买撬棍（游戏里没有任何提示说你应该这么做）
-当我正试图改接导管给门供电时，我的舱又没电了
-alt+F4，再次重启，再次，再次，再次
-这一次，我到达的那艘废弃飞船门已经是开着的
-成功启动反应堆并恢复供电
-开始从一个我不需要的房间里撬起地板，用来修补船体上的破洞，因为我没从商店买船体补片（同样，游戏没告诉我应该这么做）
-回到打捞舱给宇航服补充空气
-出于某种扭曲宇宙的原因，我的舱内温度是78乘10的21次方开尔文，气压是22乘10的21次方千帕
-死于器官衰竭
-暴怒，alt+F4，然后来写这条评测

这游戏连抢先体验都远远没准备好，简直冒犯。

费多尔，如果你读到这个，赶紧跟那个你不知为何签下的觉醒出版商断绝关系，把游戏里所有觉醒的♥♥♥都清除干净，然后回去再埋头苦干半年修bug，再重新发布这游戏。这简直是在侮辱人。
